elaine (sales): Quick heads-up — PolarBank is asking for a small POC evidence bundle before kickoff. They want SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope, a pen-test letter, and confirmation of staging access pattern. Can we assemble?

sam (security): Yep we can. Which SOC2 sections are they asking for? Controls or just attestation copy?

elaine (sales): They asked for the attestation PDF + any network segmentation and KMS separation notes. Also want signed pen-test letter template we give to third parties.

frank (infra): For staging access do they need IP allowlist or temporary SSH creds?

elaine (sales): IP allowlist + presigned SFTP for artifact upload. They said legal wants evidence delivery via a secure dropbox or SFTP.

grace (solutions): Also asked about SSO — PolarBank wants SAML metadata to configure IdP and a service account for provisioning test users.

sam (security): We can provide: 1) SOC2 attestation PDF; 2) ISO summary (scope + data residency); 3) signed pen-test letter template (non-sensitive); 4) KMS separation note (high level). Need approvals for anything with infra diagrams.

elaine (sales): Do we have a pre-approved pen-test letter we can sign and send immediately? Client expects it within 24h.

sam (security): We have a standard pen-test attestation that Legal signs. I'll ping Legal for signature. If they need a contact for scheduling the test, we can include our recommended vendor list.

frank (infra): For staging IPs: we can open a short-lived allowlist for their external scanner. Need exact CIDR(s) from the client and duration. We also need to know whether they want to run from their scanners or ours.

elaine (sales): PolarBank will run an external scan from their security team — they gave two IPs: 54.198.23.11 and 18.204.45.77. Duration requested: 48h window next Tuesday.

frank (infra): Ok. I need a ticket with owner and approval. @sam please confirm there's no policy block for that window.

sam (security): Confirmed — outbound test is fine with controls in place. We require vulnerability results to be shared under NDA and not published without permission. Also require that scans are non-invasive (no exploit attempts).

grace (solutions): For SAML metadata, we can provide SP metadata XML and a guided test flow. Do they need IdP-initiated flows?

elaine (sales): They said SP-init mainly, but might test IdP-init later. Also asked that test users are created via SCIM — do we support SCIM provisioning in staging?

frank (infra): SCIM in staging is available but behind a feature flag. We can enable for the POC tenant if security signs off. That will require a quick config change and log review for provisioning events.

sam (security): Fine with SCIM for provisioning test accounts. We will enable audit log retention for the tenant during the POC window. Also: for KMS, they want to confirm that customer-managed keys are not available in hosted POC — clarify that.

elaine (sales): They asked if we support CMK in Dedicated only. We told them CMK is for Dedicated / Private. Can you confirm wording?

sam (security): Correct: CMK/HSM integration is available with Dedicated and Private plans. Hosted accounts use Redwood-managed KMS keys and we can provide key lifecycle notes. I'll prepare a short explanation doc.

frank (infra): I can prepare the staging allowlist change and the presigned SFTP drop. Need the exact contact email for the upload and the ticket number for approval.

elaine (sales): Contact for upload: polarbank-scan@polarbank.com. Ticket outline: "PolarBank external scan window + SFTP drop + SCIM enable for POC" — can someone create and link approval?

grace (solutions): I'll spin up a short checklist for the client: required IPs, SAML SP metadata, SCIM client id/secret (test), and upload instructions. Will include sample commands: ```sftp -i /path/to/key polarbank-scan@<sftp-host>:/upload```

sam (security): I'll draft the pen-test letter and the KMS/ISO/SOC appendix. Legal will need to sign the pen-test letter. ETA for docs: ~8 business hours if Legal is quick.

frank (infra): Creating infra ticket now. Ticket ID: INF-4821. Approver: @sam (security) or @elaine (sales) can approve.

infra-bot: [ticket INF-4821 created by frank] https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821

elaine (sales): Approved by me for the allowlist and SFTP. @sam please do your security approval so we can proceed.

sam (security): Approved. @frank please proceed with allowlist for 54.198.23.11 and 18.204.45.77 from 2026-03-24T09:00Z to 2026-03-26T09:00Z. Mark logs for audit.

frank (infra): Done — rule created and scheduled, SFTP bucket created with presigned upload link. I'll DM the presigned URL and credentials to @elaine (sales) and polarbank contact once Legal signs the pen-test letter.

elaine (sales): Thanks team. I'll confirm timing with PolarBank and push for signature on NDA + pen-test acceptance. I'll update this thread when they confirm the exact window. :thumbsup:

grace (solutions): I'll drop the SP metadata and SCIM test client details in a separate message once the POC tenant is provisioned.

sam (security): Uploaded draft docs to the secure drive: https://redwood.secure/drive/polarbank-poc (internal only)

elaine (sales): Closing loop — PolarBank agreed to 24h window instead of 48h. They signed NDA. Moving forward with the scheduled window next Wed as discussed. Will send final IP window confirmation here.

frank (infra): Noted, adjusting schedule to 24h. Ticket INF-4821 updated.

elaine (sales): Great — thanks everyone.
